# Histostick™

> A histogram and a candlestick in one chart, offered as open source by 4STREET. One column per series; inside each column a bar for every value band (bar width is how many values fall in it), a line from the smallest value to the largest, and a tick at the median. Plain JavaScript and SVG, no packages, no build step.

Source repository: https://github.com/its-4Street/histostick

Machine-readable description of this project, its publisher and its bundled data: `codemeta.json` (the same content is embedded in `index.html` as JSON-LD).

## Use it

- The chart is two files: `src/histostick.js` and `src/histostick.css`. Copy both; nothing else is needed.
- `mountChart(element, { title, seriesName, columns })` draws it. A column is `{ key, label, group?, values: [{ v, date? }] }`.
- Options: `bands` (`[[lo, hi, label], ...]`), `scale` (`"log"` or `"linear"`), `format`, `sort`, `grouping` (`"none"`, `"grouped"`, `"combined"`), `widthBy` (`"count"` or `"share"`), `unit`, `bandNoun`, `valueNoun`, `showTotal`, `bandRange`, `controls`, `time`.
- `buildChart(options)` returns the SVG markup and the numbers without a browser.
- Recolour it by setting the `--hs-` variables listed at the top of `src/histostick.css`.
- To see the demo: serve this folder with any static web server (`node scripts/serve.mjs`) and open it.
- To check it, including that it is self-contained: `node scripts/verify.mjs`.

## What it will and will not do on your machine

- No packages, no install step, no build step. There is no `package.json`.
- In the browser it loads only files from its own folder. It sends nothing anywhere and stores nothing.
- The scripts use Node built-ins only. `scripts/serve.mjs` listens on this machine only (127.0.0.1).
- See `SECURITY.md`.

## Files

- `README.md`: what it is, how to run it, the data
- `src/histostick.js`, `src/histostick.css`: the chart
- `src/page.js`, `src/style.css`, `index.html`: the demonstration page
- `src/sec-data.js`, `src/sec-columns.js`: SEC respondents sample and its columns
- `src/nvda-columns.js`, `data/nvda-moves.json`: NVDA daily moves by kind of day (moves only, no prices)
- `src/nhanes-columns.js`, `data/nhanes-blood-pressure.json`: blood pressure of US adults by group (CDC NHANES)
- `src/dummy-columns.js`, `data/dummy-home-prices.json`: FICTIONAL demonstration data
- `LICENSE`: MIT. `SECURITY.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.
